title: pump.fun Callout Rewards leaderboard snapshot
disclaimer: Signals only. Not financial advice. Numbers are copied from the cited public pages; rounded display figures are stored as approximations and were not invented.

grading_notes.post_oct_10_2026: From the 10 Oct 2026 payout, rewards track whether followers profited (not volume); low-cap calls pay less. Weight 1d/1w/1m (these snapshots are dated 27 Oct 2026, after that change) more than all-time, which still includes earlier earnings.
grading_notes.high_frequency: Since 4 Oct 2026, very high-frequency callers earn less. A frequency penalty is applied only when a source publishes a call count; these snapshots do not include a total call count, so that penalty is not applied to this capture.
grading_notes.boost_only: Leaderboard presence only boosts an existing signal. A call or a leaderboard rank alone never creates a BUY.

sources.what: Top 50 per period with exact USDC paid, payout counts, public wallets, twitter ids. Field names match the pump.fun rewards board (rank, username, walletAddress, totalPaidUsdc, payoutCount, lastPaidAt). Official live API was not reachable, so these published snapshots were used. Live proxy https://calledcard.fun/api/lb returned 502.

All-time top 100 as of this time, with linked X handles and last-100-call stats (hit 2x, median peak, hold-now, avg mcap at call, followers). Rewards are rounded display values (e.g. $588K). Independent site; it says the payout board and callouts come from pump.fun public data.

sources.blocked: Cloudflare 403 (and WebFetch 500 on the leaderboard page). Unauthenticated requests from this environment did not return the live board or JSON.

sources.what: Policy context only (Oct 4 frequency cut, Oct 10 follower-profit / low-cap change). No leaderboard numbers.

sources.why_not_used_as_ranks: Pre-Oct 10 metric (volume-based). Article text names only a few figures (Slingoor $47,500 / 215 calls; lowest top-50 $6,100 / 624 calls; one earner 2,417 calls / $6,800; Shkreli ~$11,000 / 11 calls; top 50 ~$700K). The full top-50 chart is an image, not a machine-readable table. Not used as current ranks or call counts.

sources.why_not_used: No public, citable address for the Callout Rewards USDC payout distributor was identified. A similarly named memecoin mint and a Pump.fun (USDC) vault are not the rewards distributor. On-chain transfer crawling was skipped to stay inside the credit budget and to avoid inventing a sender.
